voices.name: Elise Hart - Warm, Clear & Engaging
voices.description: Warm, intelligent, and versatile, her voice brings authenticity and connection to every project. Her voice is perfect for Narrations, eLearning, Training, IVR, Call Agent and Customer Interaction.

voices.name: Grandma Maria
voices.description: Grandma Santa Maria offers a warm, comforting voice with the gentle wisdom of a seasoned storyteller. She brings kindness, clarity, and homestead charm to every narration. Ideal for children’s tales, lifestyle videos, educational content, and any project needing a soft, grandmotherly touch.

voices.name: Nana Margaret - Little Old Lady
voices.description:
Authentic, warm, elderly female for seamless performance, realistic phrasing. Perfect for high-volume content creators, including: RPGs, Audiobook Narration, Interactive Fiction, Animation, Storytelling, or Creative Media. 

Natural American/Canadian accent. Voice recorded at a high-resolution 48kHz/24-bit in a zero-reverb studio environment. Professionally engineered to ensure an exceptionally clean, uniform broadcast noise floor and level-matched for loudness.

voices.name: Mora - Gritty and Enigmatic
voices.description: A weathered, textured voice of a female character with a distinctive raspy edge. Her tone is unconventional and slightly haunting, suggesting a life lived in the shadows or a history full of secrets.

voices.name: Maria Moody - Grandmotherly Storykeeper
voices.description:
As an octogenarian, her voice carries the grace of long living: patience in the pauses, wisdom in the restraint, and kindness that never feels rehearsed. It sounds like someone who has listened more than she has spoken—and speaks now only what matters.

This voice is ideal for storytelling, letters, family history, spiritual reflection, children’s narration, and intimate long-form listening. It evokes safety, belonging, and remembrance—like sitting close while a beloved grandmother reads.
